name: iCloud Calendar
description: Your private iCloud calendar as a time-grid: one day at xs/sm, three rolling days at md, a rolling 7-day week at lg. Authenticates over CalDAV with your Apple ID + an app-specific password (set once in Settings → Plugins).

settings.name: apple_id
settings.label: Apple ID (iCloud email)
settings.help: The Apple ID whose calendars you want to show, e.g. you@icloud.com.

settings.name: app_password
settings.label: App-specific password
settings.help: Generate at appleid.apple.com → Sign-In & Security → App-Specific Passwords. Two-factor auth must be enabled. This is NOT your normal Apple ID password.

cell_options.name: calendars
cell_options.label: Calendars
cell_options.help: Comma-separated calendar names to show (matched case-insensitively). Blank = every calendar on the account.

cell_options.name: hide_labels
cell_options.label: Colour bars only
cell_options.help: Hide event titles and paint each event as a plain colour bar — a glanceable heatmap of how busy each day is.
